codex_controller.source_note: Run crossed a compatible update from f40c90a to 7507d6f; predates the final result-delivery gate.

completion_delivery.scenario: Real active workers with provisional valid completed results: withhold fields while running, deliver final report after turn completion, and keep cancelled early results unresolved.

completion_gate_review.scope: wait_line and completion/cancellation instructions; code review, separate from real-worker E2E evidence.

pi_controller.prior_failure: An earlier run closed two reviewers after consuming reports while their task states were still running. The CLI now withholds early fields and the skills require done; this fresh six-worker rerun passed.

package_ci.scope: Python syntax and CLI entry points, example TOML parsing, installation of both skills for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi.

package_checks.scope: Local install into Claude Code, Codex and Pi; runtime/reference contents; E2E exclusions; CLI help; config parsing; relative Markdown links; unchanged CLI hash.

relocated_driver.diagnostic: Herdr reported agent_prompt_stalled: no observed working or blocked state within 5000 ms; current status idle.
relocated_driver.cleanup: All panes owned by the three attempts were closed.
relocated_driver.separate_observations: A GLM horch check completed in 30 seconds. Manual dispatch of the same brief in the same worktree completed with status completed. Root cause of the startup discrepancy remains undetermined.
relocated_driver.scope: The third attempt used a local observer around command execution to retain startup state before cleanup. Command results and test assertions were unchanged. No fresh six-task pass is claimed.
relocated_driver.subsequent_resolution: See startup-diagnosis.json and startup-fixed-review.json. A leftover empty ancestor skills directory triggered Pi project trust; Herdr misclassified the dialog as idle. The new Pi ready-session guard and a fresh full loop passed.

independent_review.scope: Read-only review of controller instructions, package layout, relocation import, evidence attribution, and unchanged CLI. Later evidence-only updates were outside the pinned review.

pi_startup_fix.compatibility: Pi workers now require the installed Herdr Pi integration. No prompt is submitted without its ready-session signal. Other harness paths and released v0.1.0 are unchanged.

controller_initial_attempt.cause: Auditor mistook a quoted heredoc writing an implementation brief for reading result.json. All actual task/review/commit/CLI/cleanup assertions passed. The failure is preserved rather than relabeled.

subsequent_transcript_reanalysis.scope: Same real transcript reanalyzed after correcting literal-write and tool-output mapping. This is not a fresh integrated E2E run.

package_checks.scope: Local installation of both skills into Claude Code, Codex, and Pi; runtime/reference bytes, E2E exclusions, CLI entry points, and absence of leftover shared temporary skill directories.

independent_review.scope: Read-only review of Pi startup guard, public E2E drivers, cleanup, documentation, and first real controller transcript reanalysis. Later controller-auditor changes require separate verification.

controller_validation.scope: Two real Codex controllers completed the six-task scenario using the current skill. Their post-run transcript audits were corrected and replayed against unchanged real traces; no fresh integrated rerun is claimed.

final_auditor_review.scope: Read-only code review plus independent replay of both real traces, including a separate raw-row scan of delivery and handle ordering. Replay was judged sufficient for parser-only changes.
final_auditor_review.subsequent_change: The parent restored the existing launch-time overlap check alongside the output-time check so ordered concurrent results cannot erase overlap at launch. Both real traces passed again with unchanged counts on the final auditor hash recorded above.

pi_preflight.scope: Real Herdr missing integration via supported PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR; mixed batch and direct run reject before allocation; non-Pi and two installed Pi workers complete; owned panes absent.

limits: Automatic approval denial was not deliberately triggered.
Worker completion after more than 30 minutes was not tested.
Only the pstack implementation/review/fix/re-review workflow was exercised; Arena and other upstream workflows are not advertised as verified.
macOS runtime behavior has not been measured.
Native-subagent avoidance is a skill instruction, not a sandbox guarantee.
privacy: Public evidence omits credentials, local absolute paths, briefs, and transcripts. Other development artifacts and historical probe drivers remain local.
